# filemanager_users (Data Source)

Lists all users on the system. This data source reads from /etc/passwd on Unix/Linux systems.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) Filter users by username pattern (supports * wildcard).
- `max_uid` (Number) Maximum UID to include.
- `min_uid` (Number) Minimum UID to include (e.g., 1000 to exclude system users).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the data source.
- `uid_map` (Map of String) Map of UID (as string) to username for reverse lookup.
- `user_map` (Map of Number) Map of username to UID for easy lookup.
- `users` (Attributes List, Sensitive) List of users. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `gid` (Number) Primary group ID.
- `home_dir` (String) Home directory.
- `name` (String) Full name (GECOS field).
- `shell` (String) Login shell.
- `uid` (Number) User ID.
- `username` (String) Username.
